title: Vod
content:
The competitive League of Legends ecosystem is buzzing following the latest announcement regarding 'Vod'. As the season progresses, this development has quickly taken center stage, drawing intense scrutiny from fans, analysts, and professional players alike. The core update highlights a significant shift that is expected to have wide-ranging consequences for the regional leagues and international tournaments.

Riot Games continues to refine the competitive structure, balancing the game's high skill ceiling with spectator entertainment. The professional scene is an ever-evolving battleground where even the smallest adjustment can make or break a team's championship aspirations. Every coach, analyst, and player must stay ahead of the curve to remain competitive.

Speaking on the recent events, seasoned esports analysts noted that 'Vod  LoL Esports' is not just a temporary trend but a fundamental shift in how teams will approach their upcoming matchdays. 'Draft priority and map control are going to be completely redefined over the next few weeks,' remarked a prominent league caster. 'Teams that fail to recognize the gravity of this change will find themselves falling behind very quickly in the standings.'

As the community awaits the upcoming weekend matches, anticipation continues to build. Fans can catch all the high-stakes action live on official streaming channels, complete with expert desk analysis and live regional broadcasts. With so much on the line, the next chapter of the 2026 competitive season promises to deliver some of the most memorable moments in League of Legends esports history.

title: /dev: The Council
content:
Welcome to the first League Classic community poll. Our goal with these polls is to involve you, the community, in the direction that we take League Classic. Questions in these polls cover two broad types:

Voting can be done in “The Council” tab in the League client and is open for seven days, with the first running from August 26 through September 2. Eligible players may answer each question and change their answers until the poll closes. Each point of voting power gives one vote on each question. We’ll publish the results after voting closes in the Patch Notes.

This first poll covers questions across a few areas: game length, item revivals, and some map features. You can skip questions if you don’t have an opinion about the topic.
